RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: meat that was a man
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist who butchered a human corpse is called to answer for it by someone who knows.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} will not say the word in the hall, so the clerk writes it down instead: {OTHER_labelShort} took a knife to a human body and cut it like an animal. Everyone who was there knows. Some of them ate.

{PETITIONER_labelShort} wants the lord to say what that makes {OTHER_objective}. {OTHER_labelShort} would like the lord to remember who fed the colony that week.

How does the lord rule?

li.label: Rule that the colony ate, and the colony is grateful
Bind {OTHER_labelShort} to the post, where everyone can look
li.pastLabel: the butcher bound to the post

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: the dog he killed
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist whose bonded animal was killed by another colonist asks for redress.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{OTHER_labelShort} killed the animal that slept at the foot of {PETITIONER_labelShort}'s bed. Perhaps it was an accident. Perhaps it was in the way. {PETITIONER_labelShort} does not much care which, and has come to say so where it counts.

The animal cannot be given back. The lord is being asked what it was worth.

How does the lord rule?

li.label: Hold {OTHER_labelShort} answerable, and make {OTHER_objective} say so
Have them make peace before the court
Rule that it was an animal
li.pastLabel: ruled that it was an animal
